name: Race to Finish
description: Family watch-list races for Jellyfin. The admin picks a collection, everyone races to watch it all, and the first three finishers win titles shown on their profile. Also supports request challenges through Seerr.
overview: Family watch-list races: first to finish wins a title.

versions.changelog: First test build: header button and Option D popup (Challenges and Hall of Champions are empty for now, Profiles lists everyone on the login screen), TV remote navigation, admin setup check, blur on/off.
